rationale: HXL has broken below the 9-EMA ($79.36) and is showing signs of weakness as it drifts toward the lower end of its range. Given the broader market's significant decline (SPY -1.24%) and the rising VIX, the initial thesis of a mean reversion is being invalidated by the lack of buying support at the EMA level. Exiting now preserves capital and avoids further exposure to the downward momentum.
